annotations.title: Get the SOL unlock schedule by day, week or month for a date range.

description: Get the SOL unlock schedule by day, week or month for a date range. Dates from and to are YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive (default today and 90 days on, span up to 1,500 days). The group parameter is day (default), week (starting Monday) or month. Each period gives the SOL whose stake lockup ends then, the number of stake accounts, the delegated part (needs about one epoch to deactivate before withdrawal) and the largest single account. Periods with nothing unlocking are left out. Costs $0.002 per call, paid via x402 in USDC on Base; the first 3 paid-tool calls per day are free for MCP clients while a shared daily allowance lasts. Without x402 support, later calls return the payment requirements as an error result. Failed calls are not charged. Source: Solana mainnet-beta (stake account lockups via JSON-RPC), Public on-chain data.

group.description: day, week or month (default day) (e.g. month)
